data_gaps: module pad size and pad thickness
vocabulary_gaps: nRF52840 maps any peripheral (TWIM, SPIM, UARTE, PWM, I2S, PDM, QSPI) to any GPIO through PSEL registers. UHD has no per-instance pin-assignment override, and link derivation lifts only a composite's default profile, so bus composites for these peripherals are not declared on the part (a fixed default profile would be invented). GPIO leaves carry the bus capability tags instead.
no builders; usb and swd composites are hand-built with the existing 'usb' and 'swd' protocol types.
